I tend my small perennial plot close to the house, and it is intercropped as we always do to make the most of the little land I have. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for this plot — the cooperative price is high and I save what little cash I have for the cereal plots. But I put household manure and kitchen compost on it when I can, since that is what keeps enset and the fruit trees healthy. I use the planting material I have from my own stock and my neighbors', and I weed and tend it myself with help from family; there is no money to hire others for such a small plot.
